title: mapant - tiles CSV contract
description: One row per LiDAR tile. This file is the pipeline's input contract: any region or country can be processed by producing a CSV that satisfies it. Columns not listed here are ignored, so a source-specific extra column (Bavaria's `units`, which actually holds the Regierungsbezirk name) costs nothing.

tile.errorMessage: `tile` must be a bare .laz/.las/.zip filename with no directory component; it is the name the download is saved under, and its stem names the file in karttapullautin's input folder and the rendered tile. A .zip must hold exactly one .laz/.las file (other members are ignored); it is unpacked after download, and size_bytes/sha256 describe the .zip.

url.errorMessage: `url` must be an http(s)/s3/gs/file URL or an absolute/relative path. It is fetched by curl, so anything curl understands works.

size_bytes.errorMessage: `size_bytes` is optional; when given it must be a positive integer. The downloaded file's size is checked against it before the (much more expensive) checksum pass, and it sizes the free-space check.

sha256.errorMessage: `sha256` is the optional checksum: a bare SHA-256 (64 hex characters), or a digest prefixed with its algorithm, `sha256:<64 hex>` or `sha1:<40 hex>`. A file without one is checked by size only (and a .zip by its CRC-32s as well), which still catches a truncated download -- the common failure, and one karttapullautin would render as a plausible but wrong map rather than report -- but not a corrupt file of the right size.

crs.errorMessage: `crs` must be an `EPSG:<code>` string naming the CRS of min_x/min_y/max_x/max_y. karttapullautin cannot reproject, so every tile in one grid must share a CRS; the pipeline currently refuses input that mixes CRSs at all.

min_x.errorMessage: `min_x` must be a number in the units of `crs` (metres for a UTM zone).

min_y.errorMessage: `min_y` must be a number in the units of `crs` (metres for a UTM zone).

max_x.errorMessage: `max_x` must be a number in the units of `crs`, greater than `min_x`.

max_y.errorMessage: `max_y` must be a number in the units of `crs`, greater than `min_y`.

pullauta_ini.errorMessage: `pullauta_ini` is optional: the karttapullautin ini this tile is rendered with, as a path (relative to the launch directory, or absolute). Empty means --pullauta_ini.
